name: Ruins of the Scarlet Enclave
summary: Tucked away in the southeastern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands beyond Tyr's Hand, the Scarlet Enclave was once one of the last bastions of living humanity in northern Lordaeron. Now reduced to ruined settlements and blighted pastures, its desolate state bears quiet witness to the unrelenting reach of the Scourge.

sections.title: The Fallen Refuge
sections.body: Behind the heavily fortified bastions of Tyr's Hand lies the Scarlet Enclave, encompassing the towns and surrounding farmlands of New Avalon and Havenshire. For years, the Scarlet Crusade maintained this coastal haven as a breadbasket and recruitment base, shielded from the horrors sweeping Lordaeron. Ultimately, however, the haven was breached and shattered by the Scourge, leaving its once-thriving fields overgrown with unnatural blight, its buildings smoldering, and King's Harbor abandoned along the coast.

sections.title: A Silent Graveyard
sections.body: The ruins now sit entirely empty, blanketed in the eerie reddish-orange haze common to the Plaguelands. Blight cauldrons have poisoned the farmlands, turning the crops into grotesque, pulsing mutations and withering the nearby woods. While the Crusade clings fiercely to fortified strongholds like Tyr's Hand nearby, this southeastern enclave remains an uninhabited graveyard, serving as a stark warning of what happens when the living lose ground to the undead.

faq.answer: The Scarlet Enclave is a coastal valley in southeastern Eastern Plaguelands containing the settlements of New Avalon, Havenshire, and King's Harbor. It served as a major breadbasket and redoubt for the living members of the Scarlet Crusade before falling to ruin.

faq.q: How do you reach this area?
aliases: how to get to scarlet enclave
faq.answer: The enclave lies tucked behind the mountains of the southeastern Plaguelands, accessible primarily through the Scarlet Crusade stronghold of Tyr's Hand, or through a tunnel opening near the Noxious Glade.

faq.q: Why is the area completely empty?
aliases: why are there no mobs here
is there anything to do in scarlet enclave
faq.answer: Following its devastation, the enclave was left completely desolate. No surviving defenders, undead forces, or trade gatherers remain actively stationed here, making it a quiet, ruined monument to the fall of Lordaeron's human settlements.

faq.q: Who destroyed New Avalon and Havenshire?
faq.answer: The settlements fell to a devastating assault by the Scourge, who breached the valley, erected plague cauldrons in the fields, and slaughtered the living defenders who sought refuge on the coast.

angles.text: For humans of the Alliance, walking through the blackened fields of Havenshire and New Avalon is a painful reminder that even the most defensible civilian havens in Lordaeron have crumbled before the plague.
The ruined settlements and corrupted farmlands showcase the horrific consequences of the Holy Light failing to hold back the tide of undeath in the Eastern Kingdoms.
